status: Implementation staged; no schedule or disaster recovery verified
source: Owner explicitly approved using a private Google Apps Script rather than public OAuth/app domain, then authorized Google Drive and stored Actions read-only token
preservation: This adds an implementation record to locked B003 and B004 without replacing or weakening any Locked decisions.

decisions.decision: A standalone owner-authorized Google Apps Script with drive.file permission transfers encrypted artifacts from the private GitHub Actions worker into a script-owned private Google Drive folder. No custom domain, public OAuth app, or removal of Netlify SSO is needed.
decisions.implementation_status: User confirmed Apps Script script properties; separate connected Drive metadata verified folder exists. GitHub worker staged on development/backend-foundation only; decryption key, database credentials, schedule, actual backup and restore not installed/verified.
safeguards: Never put credentials, database passwords, encryption identity, or personal backups in the repository or this chat.
Staged GitHub workflow must not be enabled on default branch before owner configures scoped secrets and offline decryption key.
Restore test including Auth and non-database settings remains mandatory before enabling private.import_control.saves_enabled.
No original Mac/iPhone prototype or local records are modified.
